name: How quickly should I address a water leak in my home?

mainEntity.name: How quickly should I address a water leak in my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should address a water leak as quickly as possible to prevent further damage and potential mold growth. Water can spread rapidly, compromising structural integrity and encouraging mildew within 24-48 hours. A swift response can significantly reduce the repair scope and associated costs. Our team at Maine Results, Inc. prioritizes quick assessments to mitigate ongoing issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: Address a water leak immediately to prevent further damage and mold growth. Rapid action minimizes repair scope and costs.
